title: Get notified of updates
summary: Subscribe to RSS feeds to get notifications of important changes and stack updates.
content_html:
Subscribe to RSS feeds to get notifications of important changes and stack updates.

RSS feeds #

  • Announcements feed: new entries in the announcements category
  • Changelogs feed: manually updated summary of changes in stack updates - example
  • Stack reports feed: automatically generated report of a given stack - example
  • Main feed: everything on this page

Guides #

Learn how to connect the feed to your existing tools:

  • Add RSS feeds to Slack
  • Add RSS feeds to Microsoft Teams
  • Send new RSS feed entries via email with Zapier
